steps.message:
FILES: rich/cells.py:143-143, rich/cells.py:180-180
CAUSE: The code for handling Zero Width Joiner (ZWJ, `\u200d`) unconditionally skips the next character (using `next()` or `index += 2`), which causes a `StopIteration` or an index overshoot if the ZWJ is at the end of the string.
FIX: Check if there is a next character before attempting to skip it in `_cell_len` and `split_graphemes`.
REPRO: Fails on original; raises `StopIteration` in `_cell_len` and produces an out-of-bounds index in `split_graphemes` for trailing ZWJ.
TESTS: rich/cells.py (implied by logic, but needs a proper test case in the test suite)
